notes.title: Blind Touch Demo Major Update - 07/20/2025
notes.content: [h3]🧭 [b]Choose between three distinct experience:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🟢 [b]Balanced:[/b] Visual aids and hints help guide you. notes.title: Blind Touch Demo Patch Notes - 06/12/2025
notes.content: [p][u]Join Discord for discussion and bug report[/u]: [url="https://discord.com/invite/pCdTJnZZqJ"]Discord Server[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to all the players who shared feedback with us![/p][p]In this update, we’ve made [b]improvements to mouse and controller sensitivity[/b] to help reduce motion sickness and improve overall comfort during gameplay.[/p][list][*][p]✅ [b]Lowered default mouse sensitivity[/b][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Increased controller stick sensitivity[/b][/p][/*][*][p]✅ Smoother camera motion and limited range of motion[/p][/*][/list][p]We understand many players want the ability to customize these settings. We're actively working on adding a [b]settings menu[/b], which will be coming in a future update. Stay tuned![/p][p]- flygogo[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623320/Blind_Touch_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🚀Steam Next Fest: Demo Major Update
notes.content:
[u]Join Discord for discussion and bug report[/u]: [url=https://discord.com/invite/pCdTJnZZqJ]Discord Server[/url]

Hi everyone, thanks so much for trying out the "Blind Touch" demo! We've been listening closely to your feedback and have just pushed a major update with some important fixes and polish.

[h2]🔧 Update Notes[/h2]

[h3]🕒 Adjusted: [/h3]
[u]Controlling cane can cause motion sickness as it's tied with the player camera, we now made a separate button to tap the cane![/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Cane control is now a separate button! 
[/b][/list]
[h3]🔊 Improved: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Cane is now more stable with better collision detection
[*] Audio custom cue is on every item
[*] Park level quality and water shader
[*] Main menu level selection screen art
[/list]
[h3]🪨 Added: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Human, bird and cat!
[*] Inspect items that have valuable memory to you
[*] Collapsible objective menu
[*] Animation: cane unfolding, character falling in dream
[/list]
[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Visual and performance optimizations
[*] Localization fixes
[/list]
We’re continuing to improve the experience leading up to Steam Next Fest, so your feedback is incredibly valuable. If you run into issues or have suggestions, please let us know!

Thanks again for your support — and stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to the Fest!

- Flygogo

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623320/Blind_Touch_Demo/

notes.title: Blind Touch Demo is LIVE! Join Discord Now
notes.content:
[u]Join Discord for game discussion: [url=https://discord.gg/pCdTJnZZqJ]Discord Server[/url][/u]

Hello everyone!

Blind Touch is my very first game, developed solo, so please bear with me if you run into any issues. Your support means the world to me, and I’m incredibly excited to share this journey with you.

Step into a world where sight is gone, and every object comes alive through sound, touch, and memory. Blind Touch is a sensory-driven narrative experience that offers a new way to explore the world

I hope you enjoy the demo!
